detail.longDescription: I create a wrapper to create a convenience function to use in many places. Also, I can double-annotate: put @classmethod before all of those occurrences. But how can I type it so that the wrapper is recognized as a classmethod wrapper is? I had a look at this: https://stackoverflow.com/a/79692249/1320237 And it seems it can be defined differently at TYPE_CHECKING. if TYPE_CHECKING: from_xcal_wrapper = classmethod else: def from_xcal_wrapper( But that looses the argument transformation and will flare up somewhere else.
